item.title: Show HN: Benzi – An AI coding assistant grounded in a live code map
item.summary: Benzi is a compiler + runtime tracer + harness and AI agent built to understand code from ground up. Challenging traditional RAG and embedding space approaches, Benzi aims to write code as cleanly as it understands it. Any feedback is greatly appriciated!
